import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import test from 'node:test';
import {committedInputs,delivery,modelFilesUnchanged,sourcePins} from './atlas-hand-xray-mri-fixture.ts';

const historical={
 'app/body-content.ts':'4df58aeec6728cefb67332fd9578f9c4e66ec204ec92d10690b9bd9b75b019d8',
 'content/hand-bone-xray.ts':'624460d95748280d06636823375e34fb2779e68f235f6064198268d9430bee6d',
 'lib/hand-bone-xray.ts':'3c2149eca9c8bcaa380f10feb48363dfaff58828c6400c5f88c8011c0a0417ef',
};
const markers=['Trace the first metacarpal','A middle phalanx lies between the PIP','The thumb distal phalanx','No radiograph or spatial registration is supplied','Anatomy/radiology review pending'];
test('saved whole website epoch retains hand X-ray source, teaching and exclusions',()=>{
 const {inputs,files,teaching}=delivery('historical');
 sourcePins(inputs,historical,'historical');
 assert.deepEqual(inputs.filter(f=>f.path.startsWith('scripts/')).map(f=>f.path),[
  'scripts/export-head-neck-module.mjs','scripts/export-space-preflight.mjs','scripts/head-neck-module-inputs.mjs','scripts/independent-source-contract.mjs']);
 assert(!inputs.some(f=>/\.before\.json|\.transition\.json|\.local\//.test(f.path)));
 assert(!files.some(f=>/ct-handoff|lacrimal-drainage-imaging-history|\.local\//.test(f.path)));
 const chunk=teaching();for(const marker of markers)assert(chunk.includes(marker),marker);
});
test('current 9f X-ray source and import are exact; original teaching and models remain',()=>{
 const {inputs,files,teaching}=delivery('current');
 committedInputs(inputs,Object.keys(historical));
 assert(!inputs.some(f=>/hand-bone-xray.*(?:\.before\.json|\.transition\.json)|\.local\//.test(f.path)));
 assert(!files.some(f=>/ct-handoff|lacrimal-drainage-imaging-history|\.local\//.test(f.path)));
 const chunk=teaching();for(const marker of markers)assert(chunk.includes(marker),marker);
 modelFilesUnchanged();
});
